gripOrHq.title: Encoder, Inc.
gripOrHq.rulesText: Code gates cost [1] less to rez while Encoder, Inc. is rezzed. All code gates have an additional "End the run" subroutine after all other subroutines.

gripOrHq.title: Political Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.

gripOrHq.title: Haunting Inquisition
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Genetics-Visionary Acquisition
gripOrHq.rulesText: Difficulty of Research agendas is reduced by 1.

heapOrArchives.title: Chicago Branch
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

discardCards.title: HQ Mole
discardCards.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from HQ. Use this ability only when accessing cards from HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

discardCards.title: Frame-Up
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on both HQ and R&D this turn. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Give the Corp 1 additional Bad Publicity point if you liberated or trashed any Black Ops cards during those runs. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

discardCards.title: Back Door to Rivals
discardCards.rulesText: [0]: Base link 2. [3]: +1 link. Gain [1] whenever you successfully use Back Door to Rivals to avoid a trace. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

discardCards.title: Demolition Run
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, do not access cards; instead, trash all rezzed ice on the fort on which you just made a run, and the Corp gives you three tags.

discardCards.title: Highlighter
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

scoreArea.title: Encryption Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

ice.title: Code Corpse
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

root.title: Omni Kismet, Ph.D.
root.rulesText: Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Chimera
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Chimera, trash a daemon.

root.title: Twenty-Four-Hour Surveillance
root.rulesText: During runs on this fort, Runner cannot use bits from stealth sources.

ice.title: Bolter Cluster
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 4 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.
